dedupe_keys.name: exergy guided machine learning optimization of waste fuel co processing in cement manufacturing

description: The cement-process research team publishes a flowsheet model, Python scripts, fitted surrogate and results for waste-fuel co-processing in a dry-process cement line. Zenodo lists forty-three files under CC BY 4.0. The package documents exergy balances, feasible substitution ranges, a Latin-hypercube training set, cross-validation, SHAP analysis and multi-objective Pareto fronts. An Aspen Plus backup represents the raw mill, preheater, calciner, kiln, cooler and finish mill. This model can compare fuel substitution, energy efficiency and operational trade-offs in cement decarbonisation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this process model. Coverage is the specified reference line and pinned solver conditions, not all kiln designs or commercial guarantees. A limitation is that the stages solving the flowsheet require Aspen Plus COM automation on Windows; other analyses use saved tables. A supplied surrogate was trained on accepted model runs, not field interventions. No model or data file was downloaded and no convergence gate was reproduced.
